entry.name: scriptPath
entry.label: Absolute path to the script whose stdout is displayed.

entry.name: triggerKind
entry.label: How the script is triggered: 0 = timed polling, 1 = realtime signal.

entry.name: interval
entry.label: Polling interval in seconds (timed trigger only).

entry.name: signalOffset
entry.label: Realtime-signal offset N, listened on as SIGRTMIN+N (signal trigger only).
